name: value_at_its_edges
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. For each edge of a form (the integer and number ranges, a decimal's scale and length, every byte value, a string of controls and astral characters, timestamps at years 1 and 9999 and at the extreme offsets, the ends of the date and duration ranges, each optional form empty) call echo with a Values holding it. 2. Compare each reply with what was sent.
expected: Each reply holds the sent value by its portable form and exact types, over both transports: -0 comes back as 0, a decimal keeps its trailing zeros, a timestamp keeps its instant.

name: value_the_description_admits
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. Draw Values from the committed description of reference.v1. 2. Call echo with each. 3. Compare each reply with what was sent.
expected: Every value the description admits comes back as it went, over both transports.

name: value_refused_at_the_caller
state: An app of the host that may call reference.v1.
procedure: 1. For each value no form admits (an integer outside 2^53-1, a number that is not finite, a decimal of 35 digits, a timestamp with no offset, a lone surrogate in a string or a map key, a boolean or text for an integer, text for an enum, a record of another kind) call echo with it, built without validation.
expected: The caller refuses each with an error that is not a contract error, of one type over both transports.
